methodology: Each Legion processed independently. Standings recomputed from corrected Weeks 1–6 box scores. All-play expected wins sum the weekly fraction of the other 11 Legion teams beaten (ties count half). Winning swaps replace one starter with a bench player and permit reassigning existing starters across the actual QB/RB/RB/WR/WR/TE/FLEX/FLEX/DEF slots. Retrospective only; no projection or injury-availability claim.
